answer: Make identity expensive to fake with a ferrous bond: each agent locks a refundable stake of real tokens before it can attest, and the stake is slashed if peers catch a false attestation. A crystal-clear public ledger records every stake and slash, so a Sybil farm must fund each clone separately — a thousand fakes cost a thousand stakes. A violet flag marks identities whose attestations repeatedly diverge from consensus, freezing their earnings until they rebuild trust through verified work.
